prompt: What was the net revenue per unit sold in January 2025, from order_date 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-31 with both days included? Work it out as the total net_revenue_eur divided by the total units. Which query returns it as revenue_per_unit?

options.text:
SELECT AVG(net_revenue_eur / units) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'

SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'

SELECT AVG(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'

SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(*) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
